title: ExchangeAccessTokenResponse
description: Exchange auth token to access token.

access_token.description: The bearer access token to use to authenticate to Canva REST API endpoints. If requested using a `authorization_code` or `refresh_token`, this allows you to act on behalf of a user.

refresh_token.description: The token that you can use to refresh the access token.

token_type.description: The token type returned. This is always `Bearer`.

expires_in.description: The expiry time (in seconds) for the access token.

scope.description: The [scopes](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/scopes/) that the token has been granted.
